captions.dinner:
Someone at this table once told me I'd never be able to pick up the bill.

I didn't argue. I wrote it down. One line, private, dated.

That line became the standard I trained against for 30 days. Tonight it was just dinner.

Step 1 of the Receipts system is that line. The template is free, link in bio.

#receipts #provethemwrong #30daychallenge #selfimprovement #consistency
